scenes.title: Change Data Capture with Debezium
scenes.subtitle: Streaming every database change as an event
scenes.narration: Change data capture streams every insert, update, and delete from a database into Kafka, and Debezium is the leading tool for it.

scenes.title: What CDC Gives You
bullets: Reads the database transaction log, not the tables
Emits an event for every row-level change
Low impact on the source database
Keeps downstream systems continuously in sync
scenes.narration: Change data capture reads the database's transaction log rather than repeatedly querying tables. It emits a Kafka event for every row-level insert, update, and delete. Because it tails the log, it puts very little load on the source database. The result is that downstream systems stay continuously in sync instead of relying on periodic batch exports.

scenes.title: How Debezium Captures Changes
steps: Event published to a Kafka topic
scenes.narration: The flow starts when an application updates a row in the source database. The database records that change in its write-ahead log as part of the commit. Debezium, running as a Kafka Connect source connector, reads that log entry. It then publishes a structured change event to a Kafka topic, capturing both the old and new values.

scenes.title: CDC vs Batch Polling
scenes.narration: The older approach polls tables on a schedule, which misses deletes and intermediate states between polls, all while loading the database and delivering stale data. Debezium instead tails the transaction log, so it captures every change including deletes in near real time. It does this with minimal overhead, making it far better for keeping systems synchronized.

scenes.title: A Debezium Postgres Connector
scenes.narration: This registers a Debezium Postgres connector through the Kafka Connect REST API. It connects to the shop database and uses the pgoutput logical decoding plugin to read the write-ahead log. The table include list scopes capture to the public orders table. Debezium then streams every change to topics prefixed with cdc, one topic per captured table.

scenes.text: CDC with Debezium powers replication, cache invalidation, search indexing, and event-driven microservices from a single source of truth: your database.
